Game Overview

ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter puts players into a shooter experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter?

ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter is a free shooter game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter free to play?

Yes, ObbloxGun.io 3D FPS Shooter is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
